name: lld
description: LLVM linker (lld), built as a standalone component against the already-installed LLVM 21.1.8, providing a modern non-GNU alternative to GNU ld.
build: cmake -G Ninja -S llvm-project-21.1.8.src/lld -B llvm-project-21.1.8.src/lld/build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D LLVM_DIR="$PREFIX/lib/cmake/llvm"
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
